text: Can you make me a spreadsheet listing the eight planets with how far each is from the sun and how wide it is? Sort them by distance from the sun, and put a total at the bottom of the width column.
I've attached my expenses export. Please turn it into an Excel file that has a summary sheet with the total for each category, and add a chart of those totals.
Please write a one-page letter to my landlord asking them to fix the heating, which has been broken for two weeks. Polite but firm. I'm Dana Reyes, 12 Elm Street, Apartment 4. I need it as a PDF.

Make a short presentation, five slides, introducing our bakery's new sourdough line: what it is, the ingredients (flour, water, salt and our starter), the price ($6.50 a loaf), where people can buy it (our shop on Main Street and the Saturday market), and a closing thank-you slide.
Could you turn the attached Word document into a PDF, and tell me how many words it has?
Here's a photo of a receipt. Put the items and their prices into a spreadsheet and add up the total.
The totals in my budget spreadsheet look wrong. Can you fix them and send it back?
I don't have time to read the attached report. What are the three main findings, in plain words?
The files in the attached zip have dates written in their names. Rename them so each starts with the date as YYYY-MM-DD followed by an underscore and the rest of the name, and give me the zip back.
Make me a bar chart picture of our quarterly sales: Q1 was 120 thousand, Q2 135 thousand, Q3 98 thousand and Q4 160 thousand dollars.
Draft an email to my team saying the office will be closed this Friday for maintenance and everyone should work from home. Don't send it, just give me the text.
What's the latest released version of the Firecracker microVM project, and when did it come out? A short answer with a link to where you found it is fine.
Compare the populations of Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Finland and Iceland using the latest figures you can find. Put them in a table I can download, and tell me which is largest.
Every weekday at 9am I want a reminder to check the shared support inbox. Can you set that up?
